content.text:
The landing page is in `src/App.vue` and `npm run build` passes with no errors. I haven't opened it in a browser or tested it with a keyboard or screen reader.

- **Title and intro:** the page has an `h1` and a short intro paragraph.
- **Track cards:** Board games, Digital and Live-action are `CabCard`s with `href` set to `/tracks/board`, `/tracks/digital` and `/tracks/larp`. The whole card is clickable, but there is only one tab stop per card, on its title link.
- **Sign-up form:** it has name, email, an experience-level select and a code-of-conduct checkbox. Validation runs when the form is submitted, not by disabling the button.
  - Each failing field shows an error message, and focus moves to the first invalid field.
  - The code-of-conduct error is my own `role="alert"` paragraph, because `CabCheckbox` has no `error` prop.
  - Email is only checked for a basic `name@example.com` shape.
- **Email reminders:** a `CabSwitch` saves the moment it's toggled, and a polite live region announces "turned on/off. Saved." The save itself is a placeholder in `setReminders` that only updates local state and the announcement. Replace it with a real API call.
- **Confirmation:** a valid submit opens a `CabDialog` summarising name, email and experience, with "Go back" and "Confirm booking". Confirming replaces the form with a "you're booked" status message. The booking itself isn't sent anywhere yet.
- **Styling and navigation:** styles use `--cab-*` tokens only (I checked them against the token list), and there is a skip link to the sign-up section.

The track links point to routes that don't exist in this app yet, so they'll 404 until those pages are added.
